01.text: Open **https://192.168.30.30** in a browser and log in as **admin**.

03.text: On the **General** tab, click **Create** to add mirroring session 1.

04.text: In the session row, set **Dest. Port** to **P0.8**, then click **Set Values**.

05.text: Open the **Port** tab. Tick **Ingress Mirroring** and **Egress Mirroring** for **P0.1 to P0.7** (leave P0.8 clear), then click **Set Values**.

06.text: Go back to the **General** tab, tick **Mirroring**, then click **Set Values**.

07.text: Check that the session **Status** shows **active**. Port P0.8 now carries a copy of all traffic on P0.1 to P0.7.

08.text: Connect the capture device to **P0.8**. The switch saves the change by itself within about a minute.

title: Enable Port Mirroring (SPAN) on a SCALANCE Switch
intro: Copy all traffic on ports P0.1 to P0.7 to port P0.8, so a capture device (Wireshark laptop or IDS sensor) on P0.8 can see it.
subtitle: Example: SW-Ops 192.168.30.30 (SCALANCE XC208G)
before: Pick a **free port** as the mirror port. It stops carrying normal traffic.

verify.title: Check from the CLI (optional)
verify.text: Log in over SSH and run:
verify.code:
show monitor session 1

 Session     : 1
 Source Ports
   Both            : Gi0/1,Gi0/2,Gi0/3,Gi0/4,Gi0/5,Gi0/6,Gi0/7
 Destination Ports : Gi0/8
 Status            : Active

undo: **Turn off:** on the General tab, untick **Mirroring** and click **Set Values**.
**Remove:** tick **Select** on the session row and click **Delete**.
